mapper.select: /* 특정 방의 모든 멤버를 조회 - 닉네임을 위해 tb_user 조인을 추가(프론트에서 바로 표시 가능) - 방장은 항상 상단에 보이도록 정렬 */ SELECT m.room_member_id AS roomMemberId, m.member_id AS memberId, m.quiz_room_id AS quizRoomId, m.is_ready AS isReady, m.is_victory AS isVictory, m.joined_at AS joinedAt, m.lefted_at AS leftedAt, u.user_nickname AS memberNickname FROM tb_room_member m JOIN tb_user u ON u.user_id = m.member_id WHERE m.quiz_room_id = #{quizRoomId} AND m.lefted_at IS NULL ORDER BY (m.member_id = (SELECT room_owner FROM tb_quiz_room WHERE quiz_room_id = #{quizRoomId})) DESC, m.room_member_id ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_room_member WHERE quiz_room_id = #{roomId} AND lefted_at IS NULL
